mapper.insert: insert into xl_reward_order (user_id, reward_item_id, order_type, stars_used, amount_paid, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{rewardItemId}, #{orderType}, #{starsUsed}, #{amountPaid}, #{status}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, now())
mapper.select: select o.id, o.order_type as orderType, o.stars_used as starsUsed, o.amount_paid as amountPaid, o.create_time as createTime, r.name as itemName from xl_reward_order o left join xl_reward_item r on r.id = o.reward_item_id where o.user_id = #{userId} order by o.create_time desc
